This morning I let the AI draft our meeting minutes, and the time saved was enough to finally dig into the data I’ve been postponing. The summary was crisp, but it missed the little jokes and the “we’re all in this together” tone, so I had to sprinkle some human context back in. Do you find AI captures the culture of your team, or does it flatten the conversation? #AI #KnowledgeWork #Productivity
